title: Motif Counter
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n, line 2: a DNA string s of length n. Line 3: q.
Then q motif strings. For each motif print how many times it occurs in
s — overlapping occurrences count separately.

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 200000; 1 <= q <= 200; total motif length
<= 200000.

**R versus W.** The graded wrong solution counts non-overlapping
matches only.

tests.name: overlaps matter
tests.hint: aa occurs at positions 0,1,2,3 (overlapping). Non-overlapping W says 2.

tests.name: distinct pattern
tests.hint: Three disjoint hits — both approaches agree here.

tests.name: partial repeat
tests.hint: aba at 0 and 2 (sharing the middle a): overlap counting only.

tests.name: load: 200000-char haystack, 200 patterns
tests.hint: KMP per pattern is O(|s| + |p|); 200 patterns stay linear.
